summary: Three strong-value candidates remain active: a 2023 Subaru Forester Limited AWD in Cherry Hill, NJ; a 2022 Honda CR‑V EX‑L AWD in Langhorne, PA; and a 2020 Toyota RAV4 LE AWD in Chester Springs, PA. All are model year 2020 or newer, under 50,000 mi, and from reliable models. No hybrids present with especially strong evidence today.

trimComparisons.model: Subaru Forester Limited vs Honda CR‑V EX‑L
trimComparisons.comparison: The 2023 Forester Limited includes AWD, Apple CarPlay, safety features (lane-keeping, reverse camera), and a fixed doc‑fee-inclusive price of $28,594 with miles under 50 k; the 2022 CR‑V EX‑L offers leather, adaptive cruise, blind‑spot monitoring, slightly higher price (~$29.8 k) but low mileage and upscale trim.

trimComparisons.model: Honda CR‑V EX‑L vs Toyota RAV4 LE
trimComparisons.comparison: The CR‑V EX‑L is better‑equipped with leather, adaptive cruise, blind‑spot monitoring and Apple CarPlay versus the RAV4 LE’s more basic trims; however the RAV4 is significantly cheaper (~$26.5 k) and still includes blind‑spot monitor and CarPlay as listed.
